DemoPolicy.description:
Versioned deterministic policy used only by the replayable MVP demo.

The values are pre-registered demo thresholds, not calibrated industry norms.
LLM output is deliberately absent from this schema and from ``classify_decision``.

ProductBriefDraft.description:
Persistable, explicitly incomplete Brief used before the readiness gate.

Fields are never completed by the Agent.  The service promotes a draft to
``BRIEF_READY`` only when the same payload validates as ``ProductBrief``.
